text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff! Just a hundred more meters!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Only one rival in my way to take down,
and then
I win!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah...
I've got this! I'm gonna win! Just
keep
going! Just... keep...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Damn it! Damn it all straight to
hell!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch, it's still only three o'clock.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I guess I'll do some work.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Starting today, I've got a trainer with
me. I have
to start seriously preparing
for my debut.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (It's finally beginning...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the first day of training since
Air Shakur
signed the trainer contract.
Murmurs race across
the training track.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that person over there
Shakur's trainer?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Really?! You mean that Shakur?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I saw her go off one time... It was
terrifying.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I heard the teachers have a hard time
with her
too, 'cause of how crazy smart
she is.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta have either nerves of steel
or be the literal
cream of the crop to
take her on as a trainee.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My heart begins to pound under the
weight of the
curious gazes centering on
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Just shut them out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Everywhere I go, I'm surrounded by
extraneous noise. If you let every little
thing distract you,
there'll be no end to
it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, so to speak. At any rate, even
though
you're just here for show, it'll be
a pain if you
start freakin' out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Uh, just what it sounds like? I hope
you're not
under the illusion that I
expect anything out of
you.
choice_data_list: An ornament...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm running a simulation modeled
on
estimations about my debut race.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse, left-handed, turf,
2,000
meters, cloudy, firm track...
choice_data_list: A simulation?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Parcae has determined these to be the
optimal
conditions for my debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Parcae is a computer that Shakur built to
kick off
her racing career. She even
engineered the OS
and programs herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shakur views the system as her training
partner. She collects data, then Parcae
processes it into
training plans, which
she trusts unequivocally.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna watch, that's up to you.
Just don't
bother me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur moves to the inner lane, but
hangs way back, like she's trying to stay
behind the pack.
Then, just as she
approaches the final turn...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: HYAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She accelerates toward the finish line.
She runs efficiently, with no wasted
effort, yet with determination. That
honed power is truly something to
behold.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
That run would put me around fifth
place.
choice_data_list: That was an incredible run!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Although, my optimal route doesn't have

anything to do with my debut race
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Come here. I'll brief you on the races I'm
planning
to run.
choice_data_list: The 'best route'...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...There we go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur connects her computer to a
monitor,
and the Parcae screen appears.
A number catches
my eye right away.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, that.
I'm not really sure.
choice_data_list: What does that “991031021222” in t...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No idea why, but it's been there ever
since I had
Parcae plan my race
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's not usually there,
no. I can't seem to erase it
either, but you can just ignore it.
It's not like it's
causing any problems.
choice_data_list: Does that actually happen?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's get back to discussing my
racing
agenda.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The optimal route Parcae calculated is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Debut, and then follow up with the Hopeful
Stakes. Then the Satsuki Sho,
Japanese Derby, Kikuka Sho, and the
Japan Cup for my classic
year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is a series of
races that Umamusume get only one
chance to compete in. It consists of the
Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Anyone who manages to win all three is
crowned
a Triple Crown champion, a
title of uncontested
strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The most important race by far is the
Japanese
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Parcae estimates that I'll lose the Derby
by seven
centimeters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That seven is cold, hard data. Neither
hard work
nor aspirations can overturn
the harsh truth of
reality.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've tried swapping out data and
inputting all
kinds of patterns, but that
figure has never
budged.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: This must be what they call fate.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even if I train to my absolute limit, and
reach the
values Parcae is guiding me
toward...
choice_data_list: Destiny...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll only be able to win the Satsuki Sho
and the Kikuka Sho. I still won't be able
to break the
seven-centimeter gap in the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Parcae is unable to determine a single
route with
better results, which means
there is none. But...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've already looked everywhere. No
stone
unturned.
choice_data_list: So you'll be searching for that fr...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: Could it be stuck to the bottom of...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's a metaphor. As if I'd make such a
stupid
mistake in my coding.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Now, the reason I've been so thorough
with my
explanation was to make sure
you understand the
training plan.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
First off, I'm gonna raise my stats to the
ideal values for winning the Satsuki Sho
and the Kikuka Sho. I'll leave the how to
you, so come up with an appropriate
training schedule.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you. You remember that you're
supposed to
be a trainer, right?
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: For now, anyway.
choice_data_list: Still, even if it's just a figurine...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
However, you might prove to have a
non-zero amount of use as an
unquantifiable influence—a
variable
outside the equation.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You could be what leads to me
overcoming the unassailable
seven-centimeter gap derived from
all
my data. A miracle, in other words.
choice_data_list: Unknown factors?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm kidding, by the way. But the fact
remains that
I'm finished if I keep going
the way I am now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I need to at least consider the
possibility
that
you'll be able to turn the tables
somehow.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Like I said, I'm not actually expecting
anything
from you.
choice_data_list: I'll do whatever I can!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's a long shot, but do whatever you
want.
Providing it doesn't actually harm
me.
choice_data_list: I'll make sure my efforts are actu...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, she's given me a chance to
prove myself. As such, I'd like to think
about what I can
do, including in the
long term.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: What's the "best route" for the Se...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For just a moment, a dark shadow
flashes across
Air Shakur's eyes, but she
recovers quickly.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Do you need to know that right now?
Just focus
on what's in front of you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like she's not telling me something

important. And I have a hunch that it's
something
I should know as her trainer.
choice_data_list: (Maybe so, but...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This conversation's over. Don't follow
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I don't want you causin' me any trouble
out of
ignorance, so I'm sharing
information on a
need-to-know basis.
choice_data_list: Will you tell me the answer to tha...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of tellin' you
anything beyond that. Honestly, even
the seven-centimeter gap issue doesn't
really affect the process, so I didn't 
really wanna talk about it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And there it is.
This is exactly the crap I
don't
want.
choice_data_list: But I signed the contract because ...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What would you even do if answered? If
all you
can do is say, "Oh, I see," then
there's no point.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Or do you think you can actually do
something?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: If you don't know, you can't even ...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: I'd rather know now than fall behind.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All right, you want my optimal route for
senior
year? There isn't one.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
According to Parcae's predictions, I'm
not gonna
win a single race after the
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to change the horrible future
fate has
in store for me, I've gotta nip
this problem right in
the bud.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I need to overcome the

seven-centimeter gap.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. It'd suck to put in a ton of
work for
nothing.
choice_data_list: So that's why you're so fixated on...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So... what're you gonna do to help? Pray for a miracle?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Now I'm even more fired up!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: I'll do everything I can for your ...
I'll do my absolute best for your ...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh, gross. I'm outta here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: Let's change destiny.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
How can you say that with a straight
face?
